review.algorithm_assessment: Every story edge must be traversed at least once. Give each original edge lower bound one and its actual reading cost, and add a zero-cost reset edge from every branching point to the first. Feasible integral circulations decompose into complete or voluntarily reset playthroughs; conversely every schedule gives such a circulation. Since the original graph is acyclic and reachable, every cycle uses a reset and is playable from the start. Pay all mandatory edges once, then balance their degree deficits by a min-cost flow with residual reverse edges. Successive shortest augmenting paths use nonnegative reduced costs and updated potentials; added original-edge flow represents genuine repeated reading, while resetting costs zero. Parallel choices remain distinct mandatory edges.
